test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Manan said that he had no work to do that day.

options.text: Manan said, “Have I no work to do today?”
Manan said, “I have no work to do today.”
Manan says, “I had no work to do that day.”
Manan said, “I have no work to do that day.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Manan said, “I have no work to do today.”**
